* Identifies, researches, and validates all customer deductions, i.e., claims or short pays, taken on payments.

None

* Ability to analyze accounting and/or credit documents for accuracy & challenge questionable data.

**Job description**
===================

The role

The India Sales Operations Manager is a strategic partner to the India Sales Leader and a key member of the India leadership team. The role translates APAC and company sales strategy into disciplined execution across planning, forecasting, pipeline management, deal governance, pricing, operational rhythm and team leadership. It provides fact-based insights, strengthens cross-functional alignment and removes operational barriers so the India sales organisation can deliver predictable growth, profitability and an effective customer experience.

What you'll be Doing

Go-to-market execution and leadership partnership

* Partner with the India Sales Leader and leadership team to translate business priorities into an effective operating cadence, clear actions and measurable outcomes.
* Review account segmentation, territory coverage, capacity and go-to-market execution regularly; recommend changes based on market opportunity, productivity and business priorities.
* Monitor execution across enterprise, commercial, public sector, partner and strategic-account motions, escalating roadblocks and driving timely resolution.
* Provide independent, fact-based advice on business performance, risks, opportunities and resource trade-offs.
* Connect India priorities with APAC and global Sales Operations programmes, ensuring local requirements are represented and adopted effectively.

Business planning, reporting and insights

* Lead India input to the annual operating plan, target setting and resource planning process in partnership with Sales, APAC BP & A, Finance and other functions.
* Provide country-, segment-, account- and opportunity-level analysis, including trends in revenue, bookings, pipeline, deal size, product mix, customer behaviour, routes to market and competitive activity.

* Prepare and present concise management insights, recommendations and actions for India and APAC leadership.
* Maintain reliable dashboards and management reporting, with clear definitions, data ownership and follow-through on actions.

Forecast and pipeline management

Own the end-to-end India forecasting rhythm and serve as the primary Sales Operations contact for forecast quality and submission.

* Maintain a rolling quarterly forecast view of at least six months, with clear assumptions for product, services and recurring revenue where applicable.
* Co-lead weekly forecast and pipeline reviews with Sales leadership, challenging opportunity status, timing, value, probability and next steps.

Deal governance, pricing and commercial support

* Act as the India escalation point for complex opportunities, removing process barriers and coordinating decisions across Sales, Finance, Pricing, Legal, Services, Supply Chain and regional approval teams.

* Partner with Sales Management to structure deals that balance competitiveness, revenue timing, gross margin, cash flow and long-term account profitability.
* Review contracts and non-standard terms from a commercial and operational perspective, engaging Legal and other subject-matter experts as required.
* Support customer and partner negotiations when operational or commercial leadership is needed.
* Challenge sales strategies constructively and identify alternative paths to improve win probability or reduce execution risk.

Order execution and supply alignment

* Escalate delivery, allocation and booking risks early; recommend prioritisation based on customer impact, revenue, profitability and strategic importance.
* Support Finance during quarter-end close with accurate deal-level information and resolution of outstanding operational issues.

Team leadership and capability development

* Lead, coach and develop the India Sales Operations team, setting clear objectives, service expectations and accountability.
* Build a scalable support model with documented processes, appropriate workload allocation, backup coverage and cross-training to reduce dependency on individual team members.
* Manage recruitment, onboarding, performance, development, succession, recognition and reward in line with company policies and leadership standards.
* Foster a collaborative, inclusive and high-performance culture focused on business partnership, continuous improvement and responsive execution.
* Develop team capability in forecasting, data analysis, commercial judgement, stakeholder management, systems and process governance. Have succession plan in mind, select and develop the team members capability to step up where needed and ensure business continuity is not interrupted.

Process governance and cross-functional alignment

title: Pre Sales - Team Lead
description:
About Us:

Primus Senior Living is building India’s first holistic ecosystem for Active Ageing, empowering individuals aged 50+ to live with purpose, vitality, and connection. Our vision is bold: to build and sell 5,000 senior living homes by 2030, creating vibrant communities that integrate housing, preventive wellness, and lifestyle experiences.

Website: www.primuslife.in

Role Overview

The Team Leader – Pre-Sales leads the pre-sales telecalling team and the Guest Relations Executives, driving lead engagement across inbound and outbound channels and converting qualified interest into community site visits.

This is a number-carrying leadership role, not a supervisory one. You own the site visit target for the team, the quality of every conversation that produces it, the CRM and MIS discipline behind it, and the capability of the people doing the calling. At Primus, a prospect is rarely deciding alone — they are deciding with their family, about their independence. The volume of calls matters; the quality of the conversation decides the outcome.

As Primus scales from three communities to seven, what you build here becomes the pre-sales template for every new city

1. Team Leadership — Pre-Sales Executives & GRE

● Lead, manage and develop the pre-sales telecalling team and the Guest Relations Executives across communities.

● Own hiring, onboarding, ramp and retention for the team in partnership with HR; ramp every new joiner to target within the agreed window.

● Run structured weekly 1:1s covering pipeline, call quality feedback, and one development action per person.

● Train and mentor the team on the Primus proposition, family-led decision dynamics, objection handling and empathetic customer interaction.

● Ensure the GRE experience at the community matches the promise made on the call — the handover from voice to walk-in is a single journey, not two teams.

2. Inbound & Outbound Calling — Drive the Engine

● Drive daily inbound and outbound calling activity across the team with disciplined, timely follow-ups.

● Enforce a first-response SLA on every inbound enquiry — phone, email, website, campaign, referral and walk-in — with defined escalation when breached.

● Own outbound campaign execution: database quality, calling plan, connect rates, and re-engagement of cold and lapsed leads.

● Own allocation and routing of leads across the team; ensure fair distribution and zero orphan leads.

3. Lead Qualification & Site Visit Conversion

● Own and deliver the quarterly site visit target; break it into monthly and weekly team and individual run rates and review them weekly.

● Raise qualification standards — need, eligibility, budget band, family decision-maker and timeline captured before a visit is scheduled.

● Run a daily funnel stand-up: enquiries in, connects made, consultations completed, visits scheduled, visits honoured, no-shows recovered.

● Diagnose drop-offs at stage level and intervene where the leak actually is, not where it is loudest.

● Own no-show recovery as a discipline: re-engagement calls, family-inclusive rescheduling, visit-day reminders.

● Ensure every visit handed to Sales is briefed and warm; run a weekly joint review with Sales on visit-to booking conversion and feed loss reasons back into qualification criteria.

4. Performance Monitoring, MIS & CRM Discipline

● Guarantee 100% Zoho CRM hygiene: every interaction logged, every stage accurate, every next action dated. Run a weekly audit and hold the team to it.

● Publish the weekly pre-sales MIS — funnel health, source-wise performance, SLA compliance, ageing leads, call productivity — to Sales leadership.

● Audit a defined number of calls per executive per week against a call-quality rubric; coach on the recording, not on the summary.

● Report campaign and channel-wise lead quality so marketing spend follows conversion, not volume.

5. Process & Scale

● Build and maintain the pre-sales playbook — enquiry scripts, objection handling, family-conversation guidance, competitor positioning — and keep it current.

● Convert prospect conversations into structured market intelligence for Sales and Marketing: objections, pricing perception, competitor mentions, source quality.

● Partner with Community Operations on open houses, events and community tours.

● Design pre-sales processes that are replicable in a new city as Primus scales from three to seven communities.

Candidate Profile

Must Have

● 5–8 years in pre-sales, telecalling or inside sales, with a minimum of 2 years directly leading a team and carrying a team number.

● Experience in a considered, high-ticket, long-cycle purchase — real estate, senior living, hospitality, healthcare, premium services or wealth. Real estate pre-sales preferred.

● Proven team handling: hiring, ramping, coaching and retaining frontline telecalling talent. ● Strong command of funnel data — comfortable building run-rates, reading stage-wise drop-offs, and defending a number in a review.

● Hands-on CRM ownership — Zoho CRM strongly preferred (Salesforce / HubSpot acceptable); able to configure views, audit hygiene and build reports independently.

● Advanced Microsoft Excel; able to build and own weekly MIS without support.

● Genuine empathy and patience with seniors and their families, with the maturity to hold a difficult conversation without rushing it.

Good to Have

● Experience setting up or scaling a pre-sales function across multiple locations or cities.

● Exposure to eldercare, assisted living, wellness or healthcare services.

● Experience managing a customer-facing, on-site team (GRE, front office or guest relations) alongside a tele-calling team.

How We'll Know It's the Right Person

● They can tell you exactly where their funnel leaked last quarter and what they did about it. ● They coach their team on the call recording, not on the CRM entry.

● They treat 'no-show' and 'not interested' as diagnostics, not as closure.

● They slow a conversation down when the prospect needs it — and still hit the number.

Why Join Us?

● Mission with meaning: Be part of India's first holistic eldercare ecosystem — work that changes how a generation experiences ageing, with dignity, independence and belonging at its centre.

● Build, don't inherit: Pre-sales at Primus is being designed, not maintained. You will set the playbook that seven communities will run on.

● Real growth path: As we scale pan-India, this role is the natural feeder to Manager – Pre-Sales and regional sales leadership.

● Performance-driven culture: A clear quarterly OKR scorecard, transparent targets, and an incentive structure that rewards the number you own.

● Cross-functional exposure: Work directly with Sales, Marketing, Community Operations and the Founder's Office in a fast-moving, founder-led environment.

You'll work directly with Strategy leadership and senior executives on questions spanning AI, product strategy, pricing and monetization, GTM growth, market expansion, and strategic investments. The team operates with the rigor of a top strategy consulting firm, but with one important difference: we don't stop at the recommendation. We partner across Product, Sales, Finance, and Operations to help turn strategy into action and see the impact of the decisions we help shape.

* Own high\-priority strategic initiatives from initial question through recommendation and execution.
* Tackle ambiguous company\-level problems, develop hypotheses, and create the analytical frameworks needed to answer them.

Freshworks is at an exciting point in its evolution. We're scaling a global SaaS business, expanding our enterprise presence, and navigating how AI changes the products we build, how we monetize them, and how our customers work.


For someone coming from consulting, this is an opportunity to keep the parts of the job you love—complex problems, executive exposure, analytical rigor, and variety—while gaining something that's harder to get as an advisor: ownership.


You'll see the decisions get made. You'll work alongside the teams responsible for executing them. And you'll have the opportunity to see whether the strategy actually worked.


This is a highly visible individual contributor role with exposure to senior executives and the Board, and an opportunity to build a deep understanding of how a global SaaS company operates.

At Freshworks, we have fostered an environment that enables everyone to find their true potential, purpose, and passion, welcoming colleagues of all backgrounds, genders, sexual orientations, religions, and ethnicities. **Job Description**  

HPE’s acquisition of Juniper Networks is one of the most significant moves in the company’s history, bringing two networking leaders together to build **HPE Networking**, with the ambition of creating the **best networking business on the planet**. This role sits at the center of that effort as part of **the Lead\-to\-Cash (L2C) program**, responsible for unifying quoting, ordering, and fulfillment across the combined HPE and Juniper networking portfolios onto a **single platform**, replacing fragmented legacy systems with one seamless, scalable experience for sellers, partners, and customers worldwide.


As part of a fast\-moving, **multi\-year transformation**, the team will stabilize near\-term operations, **migrate core** **platforms, onboard****businesses****and suppliers globally**, and build new capabilities from the ground up. The choices made here will shape how the combined networking business operates for years to come. You will work closely with**business leaders, IT architects, suppliers, and partner stakeholders** on a program with direct executive visibility, solving integration challenges at a scale few companies ever attempt.


For the right person, this is a rare opportunity to help**build a new business unit from its earliest days**, rather than inherit someone else’s systems. You will gain **hands\-on exposure to enterprise\-scale platform integration and cross\-functional program leadership**, with the kind of complexity and pace that can accelerate your career. If you want your work to have a visible impact on a company making a significant investment in its future, this is where that happens.

* Lead end\-to\-end implementation, configuration, enhancement, and production support of Revenue Accounting and Reporting (RAR) systems.

* Support complex revenue scenarios including multiple performance obligations, contract modifications, variable consideration, standalone selling price allocation, contract assets, contract liabilities, revenue deferrals, and adjustments.

Ensure accurate and reliable data flow from sales/order contract billing RAR General Ledger* financial reporting.

**DESCRIPTION**
---------------


We are seeking a talented, dedicated, and highly analytical Seller Manager to drive selection and in\-stock for Amazon sellers. This is a unique opportunity to play a key role on an important initiative at Amazon. This position requires a candidate with proven analytical skills with experience driving process improvement, thought leadership, and delivering results.  

The Seller Manager will be responsible for executing inventory strategies on behalf of sellers to optimize customer experience, sales, margin and turns. They will be relentlessly focused on delivering high in\-stock rates for sellers in order to meet the needs of our customers. They will dive deep into core drivers of in\-stock performance for sellers, and proactively identify opportunities to improve tools and workflows. This role interacts closely with retail and operations business partners across Amazon, and is pivotal to the growth of this strategic initiative.  

The successful candidate will communicate effectively across teams and levels, while balancing the needs and requirements of internal and external customers. Flexibility and the ability to prioritize in a changing business environment will also be key. Our team culture is goal\-oriented, collaborative and driven to achieve results. We seek an individual who is motivated by a fast\-paced and highly entrepreneurial environment who is willing to roll up their sleeves and get things done.  

  

Key job responsibilities  

Maintain excellent in\-stock rates for sellers across owned category and/or region  

Execute inventory strategies on behalf of sellers to optimize sales, turns, and inventory health  

Monitor, analyze and own key performance indicators such as in\-stock rate, procurement lead time (PLT), fill rate, forecast accuracy and days of cover (DOC)  

Forecast and manage efficient inbound and outbound inventory flows and health for sellers, including forecasting, purchasing, and removing unproductive inventory  

Drive root cause analysis/reporting on operational issues, develop action plans and project manage improvements with the ability to manage multiple, competing priorities simultaneously  

Work with internal teams collaboratively, to help drive tools and process improvements that affect purchasing and procurement workflows, with emphasis on automating tasks that are currently performed manually

* Experience analyzing data and best practices to assess performance drivers

* Experience influencing C\-level executives
